sentences.en: The advent of stormtroopers brought about a turn in trench warfare.
sentences.zh: 步兵的到来改变了阵地战的局面。

sentences.en: There is a quarrel between two countries and they digging trenchs.
sentences.zh: 两国之间发生了争端，他们正在挖壕沟。

sentences.en: After we finish digging the trench, planting the flowers will be easy.
sentences.zh: 我们挖好壕沟后，种花就容易多了。
